name: Flower Garden
description: Grandmother's flower garden: hexagon patches pieced into seven-patch flowers, each a ring of one fabric round a yellow center, set apart by a cream path.

code.style: --rule: ( --k0: @pd(@p(var(--color3), var(--color4))); --k1: @pd(@p(var(--color4), var(--color5))); --k2: @pd(@p(var(--color5), var(--color6))); --k3: @pd(@p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6))); @y(even) { --sh: 50%; } @y(odd) { --sh: 0%; } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --q: @calc(@x - 1 - floor((@y - 1) / 2)); --r: @calc(@y - 1); --g: $(((q - 3 * r) % 13 + 13) % 13); --u: @match($(g) == 1, 3, $(g) == 4, 3, $(g) == 12, 1, $(g) == 9, 1, 2); --v: @match($(g) == 10, 3, $(g) == 9, 3, $(g) == 3, 1, $(g) == 4, 1, 2); --p: $(abs(u - 2) + abs(v - 2)); --cq: $(q - u + 2); --cr: $(r - v + 2); --n: $(((5 * cq + 11 * cr) / 13 % 4 + 4) % 4); --f: @match($(g) == 0, var(--color1), $(p) == 0, var(--color2), $(n) == 0, @var(--k0), $(n) == 1, @var(--k1), $(n) == 2, @var(--k2), @var(--k3)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @var(--sh); top: -18.75%; width: 100%; height: 137.5%; background: @p(@var(--f)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--hex); clip-path: @var(--hex); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: calc(@var(--sh) - 100%); top: -18.75%; width: @match(x == 1, 100%, 0%); height: 137.5%; background: @p(@var(--f)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--hex); clip-path: @var(--hex); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --hex: polygon(50% 2.5%, 97.5% 28.41%, 97.5% 71.59%, 50% 97.5%, 2.5% 71.59%, 2.5% 28.41%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
